blocks.t: Fits directly into Cerner workflows

Heidi launches with patient and encounter context already in place, so clinicians can start immediately within Cerner without an additional system or login, making it easy to scale across teams and departments.
10 hours per clinician per week
Saved on documentation, increasing productivity and eliminating copy-paste.
65% adoption in the first month

200+ specialties using Heidi
Used across inpatient, outpatient, and emergency settings, including PowerChart and FirstNet.

blocks.t: How Heidi integrates with Cerner
Heidi captures documentation during the patient visit and writes it back to Cerner as drafts mapped to the existing fields.
Embedded in the patient chart
Launched from the chart and encounter view, with patient and visit already in context.
Structured writeback to Cerner
Notes are written to the correct fields in Cerner and saved as drafts for review and sign-off, without overwriting existing records.
Built on Cerner’s SMART on FHIR framework
Provides secure authentication and controlled data access, so documentation flows through Cerner’s existing security and governance controls.
